messages:
maria_oncall: quick postmortem sync for customer Vega: isolation incident caused by VPC peering tear + on-prem packet drops. need to assign follow-ups: RCA, detection, customer checklist, comms, and a pattern tracker.
raj_prod: I'll draft the RCA and map the BGP timeline. ETA 4 business days. creating INF-4999 to track.
olivia_se: I'll compile an on-prem constraints playbook (MTU, vendor appliances, jumbo frame guidance). ETA 6 days.
kevin_sre: I'll add an alert and a health probe for peer sessions. proposed alert: peer_bgp_state == 0 and increase(peer_bgp_flaps_total[10m]) > 1. plan: alert rule in 48h, probe PR in next sprint.
tara_support: I'll own customer comms and coordinate a maintenance window with Vega. will send an interim status today.
norman_eng: noted recurring theme: similar symptoms seen with two other Dedicated customers. recommend a recurring-incident doc and a preflight MTU check in onboarding. happy to draft a short template.
maria_oncall: owners + due dates: RCA - raj_prod (due 1868159323); alert - kevin_sre (48h); on-prem playbook - olivia_se (due 1868613323); customer comms - tara_support (today). INF-4999 will be single source of truth.
raj_prod: blocker: need Vega's BGP debug dump and peer config. @maria_oncall can you confirm access?
maria_oncall: confirmed, Vega shared read-only logs via secure vault. link added to INF-4999.
kevin_sre: starting branch for alert and probe. tagging eng-sre for review.
olivia_se: playbook will include vendor-specific mitigation, packet-capture checklist, and suggested MTU ranges.
tara_support: maintenance slated for Thu 02:00 UTC, sending invites now.
maria_oncall: action items logged in INF-4999. we'll reconvene next Mon EOD or earlier if blockers. :thumbsup:
